name: WhyTrail
tagline: An agent that explains why a metric changed, and shows the query behind every number.
track: TRACK 02 - The Agent That Can Explain Why

sponsor_technology.zetaris: All evidence is read through Zetaris Lightning SQL over the direct REST API (POST /api/v1.0/sql-editor/sqls/run). Three sources (NY_TAXI, NOAA_GHCN, REF) are queried with qualified names, including a federated join across all three. The Skeptic picks its follow-up test from a fixed catalog (isolate_daytype = the federated join, baseline_variation = the period before A) and the orchestrator runs exactly what it names. The Verifier re-queries Zetaris independently to re-derive the two headline totals (period A, period B); the other numbers carry SQL/row-count/hash provenance but are not re-derived. Dataset reproduction scripts in scripts/zetaris/. Status: live end-to-end run done against a local Zetaris instance (Docker) with live Claude on real data (NY_TAXI.taxi_daily 2024-04-01..2025-02-28); traces in logs/trace-run-bf77f40c.jsonl and logs/trace-run-8180f81b.jsonl (2026-10-24, both Skeptic follow-up tests executed: isolate_daytype and baseline_variation), transcript in examples/run6_live_skeptic_followups.txt; earlier run before the follow-up catalog: logs/trace-run-b5402d4e.jsonl, examples/run5_live_zetaris_claude.txt. REST client also unit-tested against the documented request shape.
sponsor_technology.meterless: Two engines implemented from the Meterless reference architectures: World Model (WorldStore + IngestPipeline + ContextBuilder) holds the evidence ledger with provenance and is read by Skeptic and Writer; H-MEM (MemoryStore + MemoryRetrieval) persists schema facts and hypothesis verdicts across runs and is read by the Planner. Both use an injected generator. JSONL evidence in logs/.
sponsor_technology.cursor: Development environment. Project rules for Cursor Agent live in .cursor/rules/whytrail.mdc. The first skeleton commit was written with Claude Code before the Cursor workspace was set up; Cursor-made commits are tagged [cursor].
sponsor_technology.nvidia: Not used yet. Planned: route the Skeptic role to NVIDIA Nemotron through the injected generator.

data.sample_mode: Synthetic January 2024 data shaped like NY_TAXI trip aggregates, NOAA GHCN-Daily Central Park weather and US federal holidays (whytrail/sample_data.py). Not real TLC/NOAA data.
data.live: Real data on a local Zetaris instance (Docker): NY_TAXI.taxi_daily (daily x borough aggregate built from the built-in NY_TAXI sample, 2024-04-01..2025-02-28), NOAA_GHCN.central_park_daily (NOAA GHCN-Daily, CC0, through 2025-02-05) registered as a Zetaris file source, REF.us_holidays (US federal holidays CSV). Live Zetaris + Claude end-to-end runs completed (run-bf77f40c and run-8180f81b on 2026-10-24 with Skeptic follow-ups; run-b5402d4e on 2026-10-22); see README 'Live table mapping'.

pre_existing_components: None. Code written after the build window opened (2026-10-22 00:00 UTC). Zetaris getting-started docs and Meterless engine docs were used as references only.
